title: Shape coexistence and intruder-normal band  crossing in even-even Sn isotopes
speaker: 焦长峰
paperTitle: Shape coexistence and intruder-normal band crossing in even-even Sn isotopes
paperAbstract: We investigate microscopically systematic behavior of shape coexistence in even-even 106–120 Sn isotopes in the framework of the shell model. The two-particle and two-hole (2p-2h) proton excitations across the 𝑍=50 closed shell gap are essential to describe the deformed intruder states built on the first excited 0 + 2 state, which intrudes into the spherical normal states, indicating the shape coexistence. In addition, the neutron excitations to the 1⁢ℎ 11/2 orbit are important for a parabolic behavior of the intruder band with a minimum in the excitation energy near the neutron midshell 𝑁=66 point. The calculations predict that the crossing between the intruder and normal bands occurs between spin 𝐼=4 and 𝐼=6. From the potential energy surface (PES) with particle-number and angular-momentum projections, collective wave function, and quadrupole moments, it is shown that the calculations describe shape coexistence structure for the midshell Sn nuclei.
